stationMarkupEvidence.interpretation: These are broad handwritten circle marks, not exact platform endpoints. Do not bind platforms to the raw circle centres, excavate an 80m knoll, or separate platforms by ~520m.
stationMarkupEvidence.design_note: A modest local fictional grading treatment may support a common planning level; this is not a survey or construction feasibility claim.

markupFit.routeSouthMeaning: Clock tower coast departure from 105055, continuing with latest 105108 second-station and walled-city segment, ending at the south face of Lion Rock. One ~1km sketch gap between the screenshots is joined conceptually.
markupFit.routeNorthMeaning: 104949 blue sketch, south of Sha Tin northward along the river side and around the bay to Tai Po. The last section crosses contemporary water; this is user-authored fictional intent, not real railway.
markupFit.tunnelMeaning: A schematic connection only. Endpoints are picked surface pixels on opposite mountain flanks and do not define tunnel portals, rail elevations, feasibility, or a surveyed path.

route_intent_uncertainty_m.hand_drawn_stroke_interpretation: wide strokes and occlusion make the line a corridor, not exact control points

cautions: The display labels move to avoid collisions. Only corrected label ground-anchor picks initialize the fit; route pixels supply the final dense control.
Original 30m Copernicus DSM elevations include vegetation/buildings and are EGM2008, not bare-earth, not HKPD, not a historical terrain reconstruction.
Station and route coordinates are rounded to 10m only for implementation convenience. Do not infer 10m positional accuracy.
Route pixels are height-draped for recovery only. The fictional track must not inherit mountain surface heights or large river crossings as an engineering claim.

The raw yellow circles are broad locality markers; do not use their ~89m/~8m centre samples as platform elevations. The selected nearby shared station precinct is ~7–12m DSM with a fictional 9m planning level.
The north-aligned crop is a design interpretation of the red screen rectangle. It preserves approximate coverage while reducing area; it is not a unique exact answer.

planningAdjustments.shaTinSite: Common intent region shifted 67m to nearby gentle land; paired platforms 60m apart, not 527m apart.
planningAdjustments.lionRock: Named mountain control used for conceptual under-mountain segment, no rail grade claimed.
